recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-38721; any future reassessment of the extension contexts should happen against the FHIR Extension Pack workflow-episodeOfCare source.
issue_request: The Applied/Persuasive PA issue asked whether Encounter should associate to EpisodeOfCare through the workflow-episodeOfCare extension or a core element. The accepted resolution was to remove Encounter from the extension contexts because Encounter has a core property for this capability.
initial_application: No Jira-keyed FHIR-38721 commit was found in the current HL7/fhir checkout. The source-changing application was found in the FHIR Extension Pack: commit 4d698b1edea939e6cc39a7f18c169b255eb9251a removed the Encounter context from input/definitions/multiple/StructureDefinition-workflow-episodeOfCare.xml.
additional_context: Encounter is active in the core build through source/fhir.ini and source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml defines Encounter.episodeOfCare as Reference(EpisodeOfCare). The current core checkout has no active workflow-episodeOfCare StructureDefinition source to edit; current core hits are Observation guidance, the OID registry entry, and historical release snapshots. PA May 2023 WGM minutes record the FHIR-38721 persuasive vote as 5-0-1, and Zulip searches did not reveal any direct FHIR-38721 discussion or conflicting later rationale.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No HL7/fhir source files were changed because the active extension definition belongs to the FHIR Extension Pack and already omits Encounter, while core Encounter already has the direct EpisodeOfCare reference.
